final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The cause was the vendored `slugify`, which strips every non-ASCII letter. I didn't touch `vendor/`. Instead, `postSlug` in `src/blog/slug.js` now decomposes accented characters and drops the accent marks before calling `slugify`.

`src/shop/product-url.js` also mentions slugs and I didn't check it. If it uses the vendored `slugify` directly, product URLs will still lose accented letters.
